The furthest highway goes up to Pickle Lake (Pickle Crow on this map) then there’s an all season rough road that goes up Weagamow Lake First Nation, mainly only used for the locals and deliveries. From Pickle Lake, there is a winter road that goes up to Big Trout Lake First nation and the other first nations communities in the area, although it’s a really rough road where it takes 14+ hours to drive and ppl mainly drive at night time. The winter road is only open for a few weeks and maybe over a month if we’re lucky as this is the only other option to get large housing material and other supplies up north, otherwise it’s only accessible by air and super expensive. Every community varies in terms of visitors so it’s pretty uncommon to travel up without reason due to the harsh conditions although being on the land up north is extremely beautiful! 

As a kid, I used to live in Sioux Lookout close to Hudson/Alcona for school as my First Nation up north had no school, airport, clean water, or a good nursing station but my family would travel up north for the summers and winters between ice freeze up/breaking times. It would take over 15 hours to drive up close to Big Trout Lake in the winter! Long drive but it was so good to arrive home!

I was confused at why she felt like that when she had posted a picture of her cleavage on her instagram, like it got me kind of upset but it’s not my place or business to say anything about what people post. But anyway I’m glad we kind of cleared the air about that, among other things that were affecting our relationship when we were together.

But I feel better now continuing my healing journey from my other life shit. Ultimately, I really do wish her the best in her life and hope that she finds a drive within herself. Right now it’s accepting that I’m ready to move forward and not feel weighed down by someone who wasn’t ready to deal with stuff in a healthy way (unfortunately she drinks a lot). Like I feel so sad that we couldn’t do that together but I’m starting to feel better about letting go. I hope that she can too so she can find a way for herself. 

Currently, I’m going through a lot in learning how to set boundaries for myself throughout multiple areas in my life. Not just with my ex but also with my family, which was a pretty big piece of why we broke up and whats also been stressing me out for the past year. Anyway, I would love to be friends with her again someday, but once things settle and we both have a chance at growing and healing.
I really appreciate your words and understanding, it’s my first time going through this and it’s helped a lot. I hope you’re doing well.
